purpose: One collapsible question/answer row. Six instances, all on the home FAQ section.

props.question: label.large text, 4-8 words observed
props.icon: a literal "+" character, not a glyph

behaviour: public/motion/m13.js binds a click on .faq__item-title, toggles the class `active` on the item and animates .faq__content height. Every item ships display:none height:0px inline, so the accordion starts fully collapsed and NO item is open by default.

responsive.base: full-width rows in the right column of a two-column section
responsive.max-767px: body.large drops to 1rem and body.default to 0.875rem, so the question and answer converge in size
